Ten years in federal prison for exercising his First Amendment rights. Everything taken away.

When people ask Kevin how he survived losing a decade, he tells them they're asking the wrong question. He never saw it as adversity — he says, flatly, no, it was a gift.

A politically motivated case came after him over a book. He lost everything the world says matters: his freedom, his time, his years. And he still calls it the best thing that ever happened to him.

What looks like the end of your story might be clearing space for the real one.
